summary: Backend + frontend testing of Blueprint 24 (Community Rewards Funding & Redemption + Admin Financial Controls) and Blueprint 25 (Homie HQ Operations, Growth & AI Cost Intelligence). Wrote pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_blueprints_24_25.py with 21 tests: 20 passed, 1 skipped (insufficient-points path only exercised when user cannot afford biggest item — after funding fixture user has 5k pts so $25 card is affordable). Verified end-to-end: catalog with points_cost/affordable/available, idempotent redemption (same idempotency_key returns duplicate:true and does NOT double-deduct — verified balance delta = single cost), emergency mode toggles catalog.redemption_enabled and redeem->503, admin financial controls (command-center, revenue record/receive/reverse, settings PUT, provider pause/activate, fraud-reviews list), non-admin gets 403 on all 5 admin rewards endpoints, and B13 regression endpoints /api/hi/rewards/home + /activity still return 200. Homie HQ dashboard returns full shape (summary, attention.urgent/needs_review/opportunities/successes, domains.app_health/revenue/ai_cost/growth/support, connectors with posthog/sentry/paddle=dormant and internal_db/ai_usage/monitoring=connected), refresh, ai-costs (with disclaimer), insights/alerts/recommendations/approvals/experiments lists, settings GET/PUT, experiment create+decide, non-admin 403 on 6 admin HQ endpoints. Frontend (web): admin login via /auth?mode=login works; /admin loads with testIDs admin-nav-homiehq and admin-nav-rewardsfunding; Homie HQ module renders Urgent/Needs review/AI cost/Opportunities/Successes sections with connector chips (Posthog/Sentry/Paddle/Internal Db/Ai Usage/Monitoring) and Approve/Reject buttons; Rewards Funding module renders funding pool ($203 confirmed / $148 available / $5 committed / $50 reserve), liability & sustainability (green), record-revenue form (rf-amount, rf-record successfully recorded $15 affiliate), emergency Switch (rf-emergency), providers, fraud reviews. Demo user (mobile viewport) sees Redeem button (rewards-redeem) on rewards home, navigates to /home-intel/rewards/redemption showing 4,150 pts, three cards ($5/$10/$25 with points_cost and greyed-out $25 with '850 more points needed'), redeem-<id> tap succeeded (balance dropped 5150→4150, redemption history shows Delivered).
